svg.title: French West Africa interlock network

g.text: Société Alsacienne de la Côte d’Ivoire
Société du Coton africain, puis Coton…

svg.text: 32 firms in 15 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 326 firms, 1,127 interlocks, 16 components (largest 294). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 95 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
